description: Claude OS context loading manifest. Defines what truth sources must be loaded before sprint execution.

always_load.purpose: Session-level operating rules and quick reference
Modular rule files for Claude session behavior

sprint_specific.notes: Sprint contract must exist before implementation begins. Path may vary; verify in repo.

sprint_specific.purpose: Pick lifecycle state machine and adapter rules
sprint_specific.when_relevant: Sprint touches unified_picks, lifecycle adapters, or settlement

sprint_specific.purpose: Discord embed format and delivery contract
sprint_specific.when_relevant: Sprint touches Discord posting, embeds, or distribution

sprint_specific.purpose: Canonical table ownership and schema contracts
sprint_specific.when_relevant: Sprint touches database tables or schema

sprint_specific.purpose: Canonical ingestion path and provider mapping
sprint_specific.when_relevant: Sprint touches ingestion, provider_offers, or raw_props compatibility
Sprint touches agent behavior, data pipelines, or runtime flow
Sprint touches pick states, promotions, or settlement
Sprint touches GradingAgent, promotion logic, or tier assignment

optional_context.purpose: Sprint sequencing — verify current sprint is next in order
optional_context.notes: Load when starting a new sprint to verify ordering

optional_context.purpose: Which agent owns which runtime concern
optional_context.notes: Load when sprint involves agent behavior changes

optional_context.purpose: Current migration state for deprecated path work
optional_context.notes: Load when sprint involves migration or deprecated path handling
Load when sprint touches smart-form or bridge_outbox

forbidden_context_sources.source: Linear issue descriptions as architectural truth
forbidden_context_sources.reason: Linear is workflow, not truth. Verify all architectural claims against repo docs.
forbidden_context_sources.exception: Sprint planning context and intent are acceptable reads, but architectural claims must be verified.

forbidden_context_sources.reason: System state may have drifted since last session. Always re-read truth sources.
Ephemeral communication is not ratified truth.
May not reflect current system state.
forbidden_context_sources.exception: Third-party API documentation for external services (ESPN, etc.) is acceptable for integration work.

notes: Context loading is fail-closed: if a required source is missing, execution halts.
Sprint-specific context is loaded based on sprint contract declarations.
Optional context is loaded when the sprint scope intersects with that domain.
Forbidden sources may be read for planning context but never treated as architectural truth.
This manifest is the design specification. Runtime tooling to automate loading is deferred to Phase B.
